definitions.explanation: The rear portion of the head, behind and below the crown. Used in medical, descriptive, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {後頭部|こうとうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: I hit the back of my head.

examples.japanese: {後頭部|こうとうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel pain in the back of my head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧{後頭部|こうとうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I hit the back of my head hard when I fell, so I got checked at the hospital.

notes:
A compound of {後頭|こうとう} (occiput, back of the head) and ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (part, region). A standard anatomical term that is also used frequently in everyday language, especially when describing injuries, haircuts, or head-related issues.

USAGE:
Commonly appears in medical descriptions, accident reports, and everyday conversation about bumping or injuring one's head. Also used by hairstylists to describe the back area of a haircut.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後頭部|こうとうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ — to hit the back of one's head
- {後頭部|こうとうぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧ — the back of the head hurts
- {後頭部|こうとうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧ — to touch the back of one's head

RELATED WORDS:
- {前頭部|ぜんとうぶ} — forehead area; the front of the head
- {側頭部|そくとうぶ} — temple area; the side of the head
- {頭頂部|とうちょうぶ} — crown of the head; the top
